name: Terramor Flier [Racial]
body:
Take to the skies!

Prerequisite(s): Terramor, Fly 9 ranks

Benefits: You gain a fly speed of 30 feet with good maneuverability. The bonus to Fly checks from you maneuverability does not stack with that of glide.

A Land Out of Time 2013, Little Red Goblin Games LLC, Authors: Caleb Aylsworth, Scott Gladstein, Dayton Johnson, Caleb Aylsworth, Jeremiah Zerby
